metadata.title: PS3 Longplay [079] Metal Gear Rising Revengeance
metadata.creator: Spazbo4
metadata.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Spazbo3

New Game  Normal Difficulty
This game is really cool on how you can cut up a lot of things into many pieces with rarely any lag while doing so.
Since I'm not too good at the game I did die once during the final boss fight but the first time playing the game I'm sure everybody has died multiple times while facing him.
Not the best story to a game but really cool boss fights, sadly the normal gameplay is super repetitive with the zandatsu making everything incredibly easy, also if you have the fox blade upgraded all the way you don't even need to go into blade mode as just a normal swipe would cut the enemy up anyway, but I do not use the fox blade or any other weapon than Raiden's main sword or the sword you get for the final boss.
